author: Bellular News
description:
Modern Warfare 4 got an extra year, and you can see where it went: bigger set pieces, more varied missions and a campaign that won players back. Xbox is talking about the reviews. It hasn’t said how many copies it sold. Which of those numbers do you think decides how much time the next Call of Duty gets?

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!

00:00 Call of Duty breaks its losing streak
02:24 What an extra year bought Modern Warfare 4
05:39 Why publishers want games made faster
10:01 Who can still afford four years?
13:40 What if great reviews aren’t enough?
